Definition: Adajah, the name of eight Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Adaiah = "Jehovah has adorned Himself"; 1) maternal grandfather of king Josiah of Judah and native of Boscath in the lowlands of Judah; 2) a Gershonite Levite and ancestor of Asaph; 3) a Benjamite, son of Shimhi; 4) a priest, son of Jehoram; 5) ancestor of Maaseiah, one of the captains who supported Jehoiada; 6) a descendant of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 7) a descendant of another Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 8) a descendant of Pharez of the tribe of Judah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
